record.question: Rema, a building worker as per the Building & Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment & Conditions of Service) Act, 1996 applied for registration Any person but was rejected. Aggrieved by the decision, Advise as to what recourse he have to take.
options: within twenty days from the date of such decision, prefer an appeal to the Secretary of the Board or any other officer specified by the Board
within thirty days from the date of such decision, prefer an appeal to the Secretary of the Board or any other officer specified by the Board
within forty days from the date of such decision, prefer an appeal to the Secretary of the Board or any other officer specified by the Board
within fifty days from the date of such decision, prefer an appeal to the Secretary of the Board or any other officer specified by the Board
record.explanation: The source page (PDF page 2, question 10) shows the question and four time-limit options. Under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996, an aggrieved person may appeal within thirty days to the Secretary of the Board or another officer specified by the Board, so the answer is the thirty-day option. Confidence is medium because the section number was not verified against the Act text.
